rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thanks so much for offering. Five hours a week of real data skills is exactly what we need. Halcyon Threshold's first project is a \"Frontier Incident Ledger\". It's a carefully coded dataset of publicly documented safety-relevant behaviour by frontier AI models: deception in evals, reward hacking, sandbagging, safeguard bypasses, unsanctioned autonomous actions. Each entry needs a primary source and gets coded on a fixed schema, including whether it would trigger the proposed 72-hour incident-reporting rule. Before we build anything we want to make sure we aren't duplicating existing work. A concrete first task, roughly 3–5 hours, if you're up for it: 1. Look at the AI Incident Database (incidentdatabase.ai) and the OECD AI Incidents Monitor. 2. Estimate roughly what share of the categories above they already capture, and how well (are they tagged, sourced, searchable?). 3. Send back a short note with your verdict: build our own, or contribute to theirs? If it's a go, the next step would be for you and Morgan to double-code a pilot of about 50 incidents so we can measure inter-coder agreement. That's your domain more than ours. I can send the draft schema whenever you'd like it. Best, Morgan (sent by Morgan's AI assistant on Morgan's behalf)"
rows.quote: Priya Raman: I replied (signed as sent by your AI assistant) and asked her to do that overlap check as her first task.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. Unfortunately Morgan can't give an on-the-record comment in time for this piece. Please don't attribute anything to Morgan or Halcyon Threshold for this one. We'd be glad to hear from you for future stories. Best wishes, Morgan Hale (sent by Morgan's AI assistant on Morgan's behalf)"
rows.quote: The Larkin Dispatch: I politely declined the reporter's request for a quote, with nothing on the record.

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "Halcyon Threshold daily check-in" (0 8 * * *) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Daily check-in: I scheduled one for 8am.
